_curatedLinksNote: Removed the old separate 'curatedLinks' list — it duplicated these same three feeds (as plain links, unaffected by the Settings > News sources toggle, which was genuinely confusing: unchecking a source there didn't hide its link at the bottom) plus two non-feed resources. js/news.js now builds the feed links directly from the list above (so they DO respect the toggle), and 'extraLinks' below covers the two resources that aren't RSS feeds at all — kept clearly separate since there's nothing to toggle for those.
_translatedSourcesNote: Japanese-press news hubs that can't be pulled in as an RSS feed (SumoStats blocks automated fetching and publishes no feed that I could find), so js/news.js shows them as link groups with one pill per language instead of mixing them into the headline list. Each link: { lang: 'en' | 'ja', url }. https://sumostats.com/news is the English view and https://sumostats.com/ja/news the Japanese one (the /ja/ prefix is how its individual story pages are addressed).
